name: Lisabelle no Ma 4 - Albatriss Hen ~Ryuu no Shiren~
original_name: リズベルルの魔4　アルバトリス篇～竜の試練～
source:
"......A catastrophe will come. A dark, terrible disaster....."

Upon the end of their long journey, when the troupe returned to Ciel'adan they met a traveling young man, Fio, who carried a cursed sword. Compelled by white magic he had come to Ciel'adan to attempt a trial of the sword. Lisabelle's interest was piqued......

Meanwhile, another visitor hailing from a floating mass in the faraway sky also came to Ciel'adan: the protector Ayfon, with his own particular mission......

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE142231.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“……一场灾难即将来临。一场黑暗、可怕的灾难……”

漫长的旅程结束后，当剧团返回希尔丹时，他们遇到了一个带着诅咒剑的旅行年轻人菲奥。在白魔法的驱使下，他来到希尔丹尝试剑术。莉莎贝尔的兴趣被勾起来了……

与此同时，另一位来自遥远天空漂浮物的访客也来到了希尔丹：保护者艾丰，带着他自己特殊的使命……
